messages.message:
Patch Set 1:

(5 comments)

Experimental feature testing in progress, please pay attention to the comments

Some concerns, see inline comments. The two remaining OBD_FREE_LARGE_ATOMIC() callers in lustre/ptlrpc/sec_null.c and lustre/ptlrpc/sec_plain.c are still reached with spinlocks held, so this looks like it makes vfree() run in atomic context on live client paths rather than only warning that something needs fixing. Fixing those two callers (or keeping the deferred free until they are fixed) seems like it belongs in this patch.
